thread:
tay: quick brain dump — auto-fallback UX. proposal: emit compact fallback events for every degraded request (tiny payload) and keep verbose traces sampled internally for audits. public `fallback_reason` enum only: latency_quota, model_error, overcapacity, routing_quarantine. no host/node identifiers in public stream.

hiro: if we let customers see reasons, make it opt-in. suggest header `X-Redwood-Fallback-Reason: true` + Console consent toggle. otherwise teams will start depending on it in prod logic.

lucy: privacy note: include a prompt_hash prefix (sha256 first 8 chars) in compact events so we can replay under legal request, but keep raw prompts in internal store with stricter RBAC.

tay: sampling model: baseline full-trace sampling 0.2% per-customer, auto-bump to 1% during anomaly windows, emergency cap 5% with ops approval. compact events always emitted but very small.

hiro: implementation: route compact events to `fallback.compact` kafka topic with per-customer throttle and circuit-breaker. pseudoconfig: sample_rate=0.002, spike_rate=0.01, max_burst=1000/min.

lucy: Console UX: top-line "fallbacks by reason" sparkline + stacked bar, and a "view sampled traces" operator-only flow that links to rollout/version and retention tags. also a quick action to request 24h elevated sampling for debugging.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: created ticket INF-1499 "compact fallback telemetry + replay path + consent" assigned to @hiro and @lucy.

tay: next steps: hiro to draft event schema & kafka config, lucy to mock Console panel and consent copy, I'll coordinate privacy scope. meet in 36h?

lucy: works for me.

hiro: will open WIP PR tomorrow with schema.

tay: great, keep public footprint minimal while preserving deterministic replay for audits. :thumbsup:
